topic_name: Four Equal Parts of a Square
title: Equal areas, different shapes
description: Shows that four parts can have equal area without having the same shape.

title: Count the unit squares
description: Show that area is the count of unit squares, rows times columns, so the 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle beats the 8 cm by 3 cm one.

title: A diagonal makes two halves
description: Shows one diagonal cutting a 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle into two congruent triangles of 14 cm² each.

title: Longer boundary, smaller area
description: Shows a rectangle with a larger perimeter but a smaller area than another.

title: Longer boundary, smaller area
description: Show a pair of shapes where the one with the longer boundary covers fewer unit squares.

title: Double the side, four times the area
description: Shows that stretching a 2 cm square to a 4 cm square makes 4 copies of the small square, not 2.

title: A triangle is half its rectangle
description: Shows the altitude from X splitting the rectangle into two parts, each cut in half by the triangle.

title: A triangle is half its rectangle
description: Show the triangle inside its outer rectangle so that half of base times height is visible.

title: Big triangle minus small triangle
description: Shows the obtuse triangle ABC as the right triangle ADC with the right triangle ADB taken away.

title: Base, height, area
description: Shows the core move of the practice: pick a base, find its perpendicular height, take half the product.

title: One area, two heights
description: Show that the same triangle has one area whichever base and height pair is used, so a missing height can be found.

title: Four triangles, four equal areas
description: Shows the diagonals of an 8 cm by 6 cm rectangle making four triangles that differ in shape but each have 12 cm².

title: Same base, same height, same area
description: Shows that triangles on a common base with tops on a parallel line all have the same area.

title: Reflect to straighten the path
description: Show that reflecting C in line l turns B to A to C into a straight line from B to C′, crossing l at the best A.

title: Slide the top, keep the area
description: Shows the triangle slider in its simplest state: one triangle on base BC with its top A free to slide along a parallel line, area fixed at 12 cm².

title: A quadrilateral as two triangles
description: Shows a diagonal splitting a quadrilateral into two triangles whose areas add.

title: Pentagon = rectangle + triangle
description: Show a house shaped pentagon cut into one rectangle and one triangle whose areas add.

title: Rectangle minus two corners
description: Shows the shaded region found by subtracting two corner triangles from an 18 cm by 10 cm rectangle.

title: Cut and slide a parallelogram
description: Shows a parallelogram turned into a rectangle of equal area by moving one triangle.

title: Either base, its own height
description: Show that a parallelogram gives the same area with either side as base, each with its own perpendicular height.

title: Cut, slide, and get a rectangle
description: Shows the parallelogram cutter's move in one frame: the right triangle cut off one end slides to the other end to make a 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle.

topic_name: Rhombus: Half the Product of Diagonals
title: Rhombus into rectangle
description: Shows the four right triangles of a rhombus rearranged into a rectangle of one diagonal by half the other.

topic_name: Rhombus: Half the Product of Diagonals
title: Two triangles on one diagonal
description: Show a rhombus cut along one diagonal into two triangles, each with half the other diagonal as height.

topic_name: Rhombus: Half the Product of Diagonals
title: A rhombus is half its rectangle
description: Shows a rhombus with diagonals 20 cm and 15 cm inside the 20 cm by 15 cm rectangle, filling exactly half of it.

topic_name: Trapezium: Two Copies Make a Parallelogram
title: Trapezium on a grid
description: Shows a trapezium on a grid split into a square and a right triangle whose areas add.

topic_name: Trapezium: Two Copies Make a Parallelogram
title: A rectangle and two triangles
description: Show a trapezium cut by two heights into a rectangle and two end triangles whose areas add to 1/2 × h × (a + b).

topic_name: Trapezium: Two Copies Make a Parallelogram
title: Parallelogram plus triangle
description: Shows a trapezium whose slants lean the same way split by BG parallel to AD into a parallelogram and a triangle.

topic_name: Trapezium: Two Copies Make a Parallelogram
title: Two trapeziums make a parallelogram
description: Shows two copies of a trapezium joined into a parallelogram of base a + b.

topic_name: Trapezium: Two Copies Make a Parallelogram
title: Two copies make a parallelogram
description: Picture the trapezium joiner's core move: a trapezium and its turned copy snap into a parallelogram of base a + b.

title: A tabletop in A4 sheets
description: Shows a tabletop, seen from above, covered by 3 rows of 4 A4 sheets, with one sheet's size and area marked.

title: One square inch in square centimetres
description: Shows that a square inch, 2.54 cm on each side, holds 6.4516 square centimetres, not 2.54.

title: How big is a square kilometre
description: Show that a square kilometre is 1000 m by 1000 m, so it holds 1000000 square metres.

title: One square foot, 144 square inches
description: Shows a 1 ft square divided into 12 by 12 inch squares, so 1 ft² = 144 in².

title: Three area rules
description: A clean summary of three area formulas, each tied to its shape and perpendicular height.
